subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@deepfin.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + preliminary pricing (we discussed)

Hi Samir \u2014 thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same plan:

- Volume profile you shared: ~25M tokens/month initially, ramp to ~150M tokens/month over 12 months.
- Key requirements: low-latency gen (p95 < 300ms), private VPC option for audit logs, and model fallbacks for high-throughput spikes.

On pricing / unit economics, attached is a short proposal (redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf) with two baseline options:

1) Pay-as-you-go: $1,200 per 1M tokens (recommended to start for flexibility)
2) Committed monthly usage (12-mo): $850 per 1M tokens at 36M/mo commit (discounted unit)

You mentioned a target closer to $500-600 per 1M tokens if DeepFin can make a multi-year committed use and take part in our startup program. I want to be transparent about what we can do today and what needs approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to share a committed-use term sheet for the 12- and 24-month options (I attached a draft).
- Samir/Nina to confirm likely first-year ramp (low/target/high) so we can model blended unit price.
- Quick sync with Finance to circulate an approval path for startup credits + multi-year incentives if eligible.

Are you free Tue 10/20 at 11am PT for a brief pricing/terms call?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183

--
Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf (3 pages, proposal + examples)
Attachment: commitment-term-sheet.docx

Hey Marissa \u2014 really helpful recap, thanks. A couple clarifications from my side:

- Volume: the 25M tokens/month is our conservative starting model. If early experiments look good we expect to be at ~80-120M tokens/month by month 6 (we'll confirm with product by Tue).
- Latency SLOs are non-negotiable for customer-facing features; your p95 target looks fine but we need the VPC + audit log detail.

On price: as I said, our finance target for unit economics is ~ $500-600 / 1M tokens for production traffic. We are an early-stage startup (Series A) \u2014 do you have a startup program/credits? If we can get a meaningful committed-use discount and some upfront credits we can accelerate to a 24-month committed plan.

Also, what are the specific thresholds for the committed tiers? e.g., 36M/mo vs 100M/mo and the corresponding unit pricing. If you can send a short table showing blended price at different ramp scenarios that'd help.

Thanks \u2014
Samir
Co-founder & Head of Product
DeepFin AI
samir@deepfin.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing table + committed tiers (draft)

Samir \u2014 attaching the short table inline below and the commitment term sheet in the docx. TL;DR: the larger the commit and the longer the term, the closer we can get to your $500-600 target, but multi-year approval required for deepest discounts.

Committed tiers (examples):
- 36M/mo (12-mo): $850 per 1M tokens
- 100M/mo (12-mo): $650 per 1M tokens
- 100M/mo (24-mo): $525 per 1M tokens (requires Finance approval + playbook for CPI)
- 200M/mo (24-mo): $450 per 1M tokens (top-tier, multi-year incentive + startup credits applied)

Pay-as-you-go remains $1,200 per 1M tokens.

Startup program: we do offer a program (credits + onboarding discount) for qualifying Series A companies. Typical package: $75k in credits + 6 months of reduced committed pricing (applied to year 1) \u2014 needs manager approval.

I'll be honest: getting to $500/1M is possible if DeepFin commits to 24 months at ~100M+/mo and we layer startup credits / marketing co-sell, or if we make a special multi-year incentive. I'll loop Ben (my manager) for an approval path.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Tue 10/20 11am PT \u2014 I'll bring a term sheet and an approval checklist.

Best,
Marissa

--
Attachment: commitment-term-sheet.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@deepfin.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing table + committed tiers (draft)

Looping in briefly. Marissa \u2014 I reviewed the table. Quick notes: 

- Finance will sign off on $525/1M at 100M/mo for 24 months only with an approved MSP (multi-year savings plan) and a commitment to a minimum annual spend (we typically require $2.5M+ ARR-equivalent on contract).
- For startups (Series A) we can often combine a one-time $75k credit with a softened ramp schedule (year 1 step-down pricing) to reach an effective blended price near $600/1M across year 1. That is achievable with your marketing collaboration and a short co-sell agreement.
- We can offer a temporary demo/PO hold if they need procurement lead time; legal will need an approved SOW and PO.

Samir \u2014 if you can confirm a likely ramp profile (Low: 25M, Target: 80M, High: 150M) and whether you can do a 12- or 24-month term, I can route Finance to give a formal approval + the exact term sheet.

Ben
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
